signals.name: Intel Corporation
signals.label: Congress options bet + $36B govt stake gain + retail momentum
signals.detail: Nancy Pelosi disclosed buying 200 INTC call options (strike $50, expiring 19 Mar 2027, valued $1M-$5M) on 2026-05-29 -- her first trades disclosed since January 2026. The U.S. government's 9.9% equity stake (from the 2025 CHIPS/DoD conversion) had an unrealized paper gain of roughly $36B as of mid-September 2026, with INTC up ~190% YTD after a reported PC-chip price hike in early September.
signals.takeaway: A sitting congressional options bet stacked on top of a national 'strategic asset' government equity stake makes INTC one of the most politically-entangled trades on the market.

signals.name: Alphabet Inc.
signals.label: Berkshire's 83% stake surge becomes a top-3 holding
signals.detail: Berkshire Hathaway (now run day-to-day by CEO Greg Abel) grew its Alphabet stake 83% in Q2 2026 to roughly 106M shares worth about $37B, making it Berkshire's third-largest equity position (~10% of the portfolio); about 60% of the new shares (~$10B) came via a private placement, the balance via open-market buying.
signals.takeaway: A near-doubling of Berkshire's stake under the post-Buffett leadership signals unusually high institutional conviction in Alphabet right as AI/search competition intensifies.

signals.name: Micron Technology
signals.label: #1 trending on WSB into AI-memory earnings
signals.detail: MU is currently the #1 most-mentioned ticker on r/wallstreetbets (189 mentions, up ~130% week-over-week per ApeWisdom) heading into its Sept 30, 2026 earnings print; fiscal 2026 revenue is estimated to have grown nearly 3.5x y/y on AI memory demand, with an average analyst 'Strong Buy' rating.
signals.takeaway: Retail attention is peaking right into a high-stakes earnings print for the AI memory-chip supercycle narrative.

signals.name: Pan American Silver Corp.
signals.label: Silver mania continues, analyst estimates rising fast
signals.detail: PAAS is benefiting from the ongoing silver price rally and its recent MAG Silver acquisition; the Zacks consensus 2026 EPS estimate has risen 30.1% over the past 60 days (2027 estimates up 34.9%), after a prior 5-day rally sent the stock up 26% into the $48-$50 range as of Sept 17-18, 2026.
signals.takeaway: Analyst estimate revisions of this magnitude in under two months show the silver retail/institutional convergence is intensifying, not fading.

signals.name: CoreWeave, Inc.
signals.label: Dilution-driven selloff collides with AI-demand fundamentals
signals.detail: On 2026-09-17 CoreWeave announced a $3B private placement of convertible senior notes due 2033 (plus a $500M option) alongside a new equity distribution facility for up to 35M shares; shares fell as much as 7% (~$90 to ~$78) on dilution concerns, even after Q2 2026 results of $2.575B revenue and 90.6% gross margin.
signals.takeaway: Strong underlying AI-compute demand is colliding with capital-raise-driven investor anxiety, making this a genuine smart-money-vs-jittery-retail split.

signals.name: Uber Technologies, Inc.
signals.label: Pelosi call options + institutional buying vs. a stock in free fall
signals.detail: Nancy Pelosi disclosed buying 200 UBER call options (strike $50, expiring 19 Mar 2027, valued $500K-$1M) on 2026-05-29, alongside her INTC trade. UBER is down ~13% YTD as of mid-September 2026 (vs. S&P 500 +11.8%), yet Vanguard raised its position and WSB sentiment reads bullish.
signals.takeaway: A congressional call-option bet plus rising institutional ownership on a stock badly lagging the market is a classic smart-money-buying-the-dip divergence.

signals.name: Palantir Technologies Inc.
signals.label: Retail call-buying frenzy + Goldman stake vs. record insider selling
signals.detail: PLTR was among the top-10 most-traded single-stock options in early September 2026 on nearly double average volume, with retail buying roughly 2x as many calls as puts; Goldman Sachs raised its Q1 2026 stake 38.5% (to 15.18M shares), even as CEO Alex Karp sold $86M of stock on 2026-08-20 -- his largest sale of the year.
signals.takeaway: Retail options euphoria and institutional accumulation are running directly opposite the CEO's largest-ever stock sale, a textbook contrarian convergence.

signals.name: SanDisk Corporation
signals.label: S&P 100 inclusion + doubled hedge-fund stakes vs. heavy insider selling
signals.detail: SNDK jumped over 11% on 2026-09-18 (after +6% the prior day) ahead of joining the S&P 100 on 2026-09-21; hedge-fund ownership has more than doubled recently (institutional ownership 76.79%) and it's the #3 trending WSB ticker (132 mentions, +389% w/w), even as insiders sold $77.3M over the trailing 12 months, including the CEO's $51.7M sale on 2026-09-17.
signals.takeaway: An index-inclusion-driven institutional and retail stampede is colliding with unusually heavy C-suite selling on a stock up 574% in 2026 -- a yellow flag worth watching.
